d: A dream vacation turns into a murderous nightmare for an 11-year-old girl when she is orphaned and left to drown on a sinking yacht.
As the days pass, the remaining survivalists show signs of cracking.
A punishing storm batters the remaining men and gale force winds rip through their makeshift camps.
Sasquatch, Laramy Miller, hunts the badlands of Montana for mule deer.
Laramy "Sasquatch" Miller continues his hunt for a mountain lion.
This week on Sasquatch, Laramy Miller is in the Colorado mountains chasing after elk with his self-made arrows.
Laramy hunts for a spring black bear in the Rocky Mountains with his Hawken rifle. Learn some skinning techniques and uses of black bear meat, fur, and fat.
With a tag in pocket, Laramy takes to the mountains of Idaho on the hunt for the elusive elk.
Meet Laramy "Sasquatch" Miller, one of the last mountain men of the Rocky Mountains. Follow Laramy as he attempts to harvest a huge Canadian moose.
An animal he knows well, Steven Rinella heads into the mountains of the Sonora Desert on a true wild, free-ranging bison hunt.

st: The Rugged Peaks: Alaskan Mountain Goat
d: Steve holds a rare mountain goat permit to hunt the Kenai Peninsula. He and his brother backpack into the rugged mountains in hopes of finding a Billy.
In the flooded cornfields of northeastern South Dakota, Steven Rinella finds ideal conditions for duck hunting with pal Ryan Callaghan and waterfowl expert Sean Weaver.

st: El Venado Blanco: Mexico Coues Deer
d: Steven Rinella returns to his favorite hunting grounds of Sonora, MX to hunt for a Coues deer buck during the peak rutting season with Remi Warren.

st: The Best Start - Wild Game Breakfast Cooking Special
d: Following a series of successful hunts this fall, Steve demonstrates how to cook a variety of breakfast classics using wild game ingredients.

st: The Northern Rockies: British Columbia Grizzly Part 2
d: Steve and his buddy Ryan Callaghan, a British Columbia guide, hike into the steep backcountry of northern British Columbia in search of grizzlies and black bears. This alpine adventure includes some intense and up-close bear action – almost too close.
The remaining participants are finally adapting to the unforgiving environment but the search for food leads them into harm's way.
In the brutally freezing temperatures, the hunt for food becomes the paramount focus of the remaining survivalists.
The first six men to go home explain their reasons for leaving, plus an exclusive preview of the what's to come for the remaining participants.
Temperatures plummet on the island and the remaining contestants are forced to face the onset of winter head-on.
The crew scrambles to get the Dynasty jade quarry going despite failing equipment. Claudia rushes to find sellable jade for a buyer.
Robin clashes with Claudia and Josh over the quality of jade coming out of their pit, while Larry's attempt to help get the crew bunkhouse to camp goes sideways.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh, and Steve about how to mine, and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.

st: No Jade Until Blood Is Spilled
d: Robin tries to defy the laws of physics to get a massive new bunkhouse to their Wolverine claim. A serious accident shocks Jade City.
Expedition Leader Steven Moll and expedition medic Patrick McGregor take a look back at what the expedition has accomplished to date. The good, bad, and the ugly.
The men explore the remote coast of Hokkaido Island arriving in their final Japanese port, Wakkanai. Only the Straits of La Perouse separate the men from entering the Russian Federation.
